seriesTitle: Conversations with a Killer: The Ted Bundy Tapes

episodes.title: Handsome Devil
episodes.summary: Two journalists set out to get the definitive story of infamous serial killer Ted Bundy, as told by the man himself.

episodes.title: One of Us
episodes.summary: As investigators search for a suspect in the string of brutal murders near Seattle, a woman manages to escape the killer's clutches in Utah.

episodes.title: Not My Turn to Watch Him
episodes.summary: Following several brazen escapes, Bundy flees to Florida, where he unleashes a wave of atrocities. Also, a simple traffic stop spawns a mystery.

episodes.title: Burn Bundy Burn
episodes.summary: Bundy's double-murder trial transforms into a bizarre circus with an unhinged ringleader. Later, the accused makes a last-ditch effort to stay alive.
